code: war.gov record code (DOW-UAP-D044), or null for release-1 files that have none. Not unique: war.gov gave FBI-UAP-D014 to two different records; key on slug
slug: this archive's identifier; record_url is built from it
title: war.gov title (the invisible characters some carry are plain spaces here)
agency: releasing agency, as war.gov names it
agency_short: short form (DOW, FBI, NASA, CIA, DOS, DOE, ...)
incident_date: war.gov's incident date (free text); where war.gov's data file was garbled, this archive's correction (see corrected_by_archive)
incident_year: incident year parsed from the incident date (or from the title), with this archive's corrections (see corrected_by_archive)
incident_place: war.gov's incident location; where war.gov left it empty or the record contradicts it, this archive's value from the title or document (see corrected_by_archive)
realm: earth, off-earth or unknown (no single place given)
lat: latitude of the map pin this archive places for incident_place (WGS84), or null; see pin_precision
lng: longitude of that pin, or null
pin_precision: how exact the pin is: point (a site or base) or city; area (within about 100 km), state, country, region, ocean and aor (a military command's area) are approximate, pinned at the centre; document = where the document was written; null without a pin
no_incident: true when the record documents no single incident (a paper, memo, contract or personnel record): incident_date and incident_place are then the document's own date and place
corrected_by_archive: the fields of this row that hold this archive's correction of war.gov's data file instead of war.gov's value (any of incident_date, incident_year, incident_place, realm, and pin when this archive moved or removed the map pin); empty when none
archive_note: this archive's note on the record, as shown on its page (corrections, file notes), or null
featured_by_war_gov: true when war.gov featured the record (war.gov flags only its latest release and clears the flag at the next; this archive keeps the history); false where this archive holds war.gov's picks for the record's release and it is not among them; null where that release's picks were not recorded
featured_in_release: the release war.gov featured the record with, or null
redacted: war.gov's Redaction flag, as war.gov gives it (a few unflagged files carry FOIA exemption stamps)
text_unit: page (OCR of a PDF) or part (audio transcript made by this archive with speech-recognition software, ~4,000 characters each); null without text
text_units: number of pages or parts in the full-text file
words: number of words in the OCR text or transcript (0 when no text was recognized)
description: war.gov's description of the record, verbatim (spacing normalized, line breaks kept)
machine_summary: machine-written summary of the document (NOT government text), or null (only summaries this archive has checked against what they were written from are included; see machine_summary_basis)
machine_summary_basis: what it was written from: full_text, partial_text (the opening part of the text only) or metadata_only (war.gov's title and description only); null if not recorded
topics: topic slugs assigned by this archive's keyword rules over the title, war.gov's description, the document text and the place (depending on the topic; never the machine summary), some reviewed by hand; see https://declassifieduap.org/topic/
case_file: this archive's case-file id grouping records of one incident, or null
record_url: the record page on https://declassifieduap.org: cite this
war_gov_url: the original: the file on war.gov, or for video and audio the DVIDS page
file_url: this archive's copy of the file, or null; scripts send their free key (https://declassifieduap.org/developers) and follow the redirect
